speaker: provider

text.en: Your child needs vaccines. Do you have the child's vaccination book?
text.th: ลูกของคุณต้องได้รับวัคซีน คุณมีสมุดวัคซีนของเด็กไหม

source.note: Written 2026-10-13 from the disease-burden report. English and Thai are unreviewed drafts by the scaffold author.

notes: 1.5 million Myanmar under-fives missed basic vaccination; diphtheria deaths in Mae Sot 2024. This record is skipped at build until Burmese or Mon reaches status 'human'.
